citations.title: Kraken offers Jersey Mike’s IPO to retail, pairing U.S. allocations with 1:1-backed xStocks in 110+ countries
FINMA approves Switzerland’s first retail Bitcoin ETF, with custody safeguards and risk warnings

summary: Retail crypto now spans direct ownership, regulated funds, tokenized claims, derivatives, payments and delegated software. The decisive question is not merely what individuals can access, but what rights, risks and intermediaries each route introduces.
